_note: The TRES front end's calibration stage on the FLWO 60-inch: Alpaca filterwheel/0 (named positions) and focuser/0 (microns) over a PI C-663 + L-505 (docs/tres_frontend.md).
Hardware is NOT allowed: allow_hardware stays false until every item under 'Confirm on the mountain' in docs/tres_frontend.md is checked.
Then: allow_hardware true here AND --hardware on the command line, on the front-end computer the controller is plugged into.
port.device is a placeholder for that computer's serial device for the controller.

positions (mm), from the live TRES system 2026-11-02, confirm: science 3.05 (lamp light into the science fiber), sky 8.0 (into the sky fiber), out 24.99, block_sky 15.65, block_science 0. The stage is a PI M-112.22S1.
legacy_redis: the transition shim, off (null). See the doc before turning it on; it must never point at a shared server without JDE's approval.
